title: evolvulus alsinoides var. argenteus
intro: Evolvulus alsinoides var. argenteus, commonly known as Dwarf Morning Glory or Silver Evolvulus, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Evolvulus alsinoides var. argenteus may include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
